process_area.title: Revenue Assurance Strategy, Governance & Leak Detection Framework

value_stream.name: Revenue Assurance, Pricing Integrity & Leakage Management

fields.Participants: Revenue Assurance Lead, Finance (links to VS-17), FP&A (links to VS-17.4), Treasury (links to VS-18), POS/IT (links to VS-08/VS-27), Internal Audit (links to VS-21.3), Loss Prevention (links to VS-23), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Loyalty/Gift Card (links to VS-13/VS-54), Promotions (links to VS-58), Payments (links to VS-80), Cross-Entity (links to VS-72)
fields.Trigger: Annual finance planning (links to VS-33.1/VS-17.4); program review

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitoring + periodic audit" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System continuous audit of "Audit independently verifies" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approve the program budget" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: Revenue Assurance Lead authority and continuous model; operational: leakage taxonomy (W3690)
Pain Points / Risks: - **No-owner risk**: Revenue assurance done only as a monthly audit after-the-fact; mitigated by Revenue Assurance Lead authority and continuous model
- **Scope-blindness risk**: New channels (marketplace, retail media) added without assurance coverage; mitigated by leakage taxonomy (W3690)
System Touchpoints: - Finance/FP&A (links to VS-17.4); treasury (links to VS-18); POS/IT (links to VS-08/VS-27); audit (links to VS-21.3); loss prevention (links to VS-23); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Revenue Assurance Lead/Finance define the revenue-assurance program strategy and governance: scope (all revenue channels and waterfalls — POS, ecommerce, B2B/AR, marketplace/3P, retail media, loyalty/gift-card, services), the leakage taxonomy (W3690), the operating model (continuous monitoring + periodic audit), and the KPIs (leakage rate by channel, recovery rate, control-effectiveness, exception-cycle-time)

Revenue Assurance Lead establish the governance: Revenue Assurance Lead authority, the cross-functional responsibilities (Finance owns the program, IT/POS enables tooling, Loss Prevention investigates fraud, Audit independently verifies), the revenue-assurance policy, and the integration to FP&A (VS-17.4), treasury (VS-18), audit (VS-21.3), and loss prevention (VS-23)

CFO ratify the revenue-assurance strategy and policy, approve the program budget (links to VS-17.4), set the leakage-reduction target, and report revenue-assurance posture and leakage exposure to the executive risk committee (links to VS-21.2/VS-36) and board (links to VS-36); communicate the mandate

fields.Participants: Revenue Assurance Lead, Finance (links to VS-17.4), BI (links to VS-28.1), POS (links to VS-08), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Loyalty/Gift Card (links to VS-13/VS-54), Promotions (links to VS-58), Payments (links to VS-80), Loss Prevention (links to VS-23), Audit (links to VS-21.3)
fields.Trigger: Program strategy (W3689); new channel/product; loss event

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "catalog of leakage vectors" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-monitor of "map each leakage vector to the channel/system/control where it originates" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report residual exposure to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: periodic taxonomy refresh and benchmarking; operational: exposure modeling
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unmapped-vector risk**: A leakage vector not in the taxonomy goes undetected; mitigated by periodic taxonomy refresh and benchmarking
- **Exposure-blindness risk**: No quantification of potential leakage per vector; mitigated by exposure modeling
System Touchpoints: - Finance/FP&A (links to VS-17.4); BI (links to VS-28.1); POS (links to VS-08); ecommerce (links to VS-10); loyalty/gift card (links to VS-13/VS-54); promotions (links to VS-58); payments (links to VS-80); controls framework (links to W3693)

steps.activity: Revenue Assurance Lead/Finance maintain the revenue-leakage taxonomy: the catalog of leakage vectors — pricing/price-override error, promo/markdown mis-application, loyalty-points/gift-card mis-issuance or abuse, discount-stacking, mandatory-discount/tax-exempt mis-application, VAT/tax mis-calculation, catch-weight/cut-length measurement error, refund/reversal leakage, payment/MDR/fee discrepancy, settlement/timing gap, POS-to-GL data-integrity failure, ecommerce/marketplace/3P settlement gap, system-rounding

Revenue Assurance Lead map each leakage vector to the channel/system/control where it originates and the detection control that should catch it (W3693), quantify the potential exposure per vector, and risk-rank to prioritize monitoring; identify controls gaps

Revenue Assurance Lead publish the leakage taxonomy and risk map to the program, drive coverage of every vector by a monitoring control (W3693/W3697–W3704), and refresh on channel/product/control change; report residual exposure to governance (links to W3689)

fields.Participants: Revenue Assurance Lead, Finance (links to VS-17.1), Treasury (links to VS-18.1), Payments (links to VS-80), POS/IT (links to VS-08/VS-27), Bank reconciliation, Ecommerce (links to VS-10)
fields.Volume: ~PHP 5.19B monthly revenue; ~2.8M POS transactions; ~515K ecommerce orders/yr

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-reconcile of "reconcile POS gross sales" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "verify settlement integrity" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-sync of "sync failure, offline-mode gap, unbanked cash, settlement timing" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: daily reconciliation and root-cause; operational: offline-integrity check (W3692)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unreconciled-gap risk**: Sales-to-cash variance left uninvestigated masks leakage; mitigated by daily reconciliation and root-cause
- **Offline-mode risk**: POS offline transactions fail to sync, causing unrecorded sales; mitigated by offline-integrity check (W3692)
System Touchpoints: - Bank reconciliation (links to W215); treasury/cash (links to VS-18.1); payment settlement (links to VS-80.2); POS (links to VS-08); month-end close (links to VS-17.1); ecommerce (links to VS-10)

steps.activity: Revenue Assurance Lead/Finance perform sales-to-cash reconciliation: reconcile POS gross sales (by tender) to bank deposits (links to W215), ecommerce collections to payment-gateway settlement (links to VS-80.2), and AR collections to remittance (links to VS-16.3); identify and investigate unmatched/variance items daily

Revenue Assurance Lead/Payments verify settlement integrity: confirm acquirer/PSP settlement amounts, MDR/fee deductions, chargebacks and refunds reconcile to expected revenue (links to VS-80.2), and that multi-tender/split-payment transactions captured full value

Revenue Assurance Lead drive variance resolution: investigate sales-vs-cash gaps to root cause (system sync failure, offline-mode gap, unbanked cash, settlement timing), recover/correct, and feed findings to leak-detection (W3705) and controls (W3693); report reconciliation integrity to month-end close (links to VS-17.1)

fields.Participants: Revenue Assurance Lead, POS/IT (links to VS-08/VS-27.2), Finance (links to VS-17.1), Loss Prevention (links to VS-23), BI (links to VS-28.1)
fields.Trigger: Near-real-time event stream; daily integrity check; offline-mode event

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor POS transaction integrity in near-real-time" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "Revenue Assurance Lead/POS-IT assure offline-mode revenue capture" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-scan of "scan → price lookup → tender → receipt → event → ERP journal → GL revenue" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-583 (ensure controlled execution — Revenue Assurance Strategy, Governance & Leak Detection Framework (PA-118.1).)
- operational: offline-integrity monitoring; operational: idempotency checks
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sync-loss risk**: Offline/dropped transactions never reach the GL — direct revenue loss; mitigated by offline-integrity monitoring
- **Duplication risk**: Sync retries create duplicate revenue entries; mitigated by idempotency checks
System Touchpoints: - POS/event stream (links to VS-08/VS-27.2); ERP GL (links to VS-17.1); offline cache (links to VS-08); IT service mgmt (links to VS-27.1); BI (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Revenue Assurance Lead/POS-IT monitor POS transaction integrity in near-real-time: confirm every transaction (and its lines) flows POS → event stream → ERP → GL without loss/duplication, detect sequence gaps, duplicate transaction IDs, failed-sync flags, and offline-mode transactions pending sync

Revenue Assurance Lead/POS-IT assure offline-mode revenue capture: when a POS operates offline (network outage, ≥8-hour cache per profile §5), ensure the offline transaction cache syncs fully on reconnect, no transactions are lost/duplicated, and offline sales reconcile to cash; investigate sync failures

Revenue Assurance Lead trace end-to-end data integrity periodically: select sample transactions and trace from POS scan → price lookup → tender → receipt → event → ERP journal → GL revenue (the W348 step-5 test, now operationalized continuously), and remediate data-flow defects with IT (links to VS-27.1)

fields.Participants: Revenue Assurance Lead, Finance (links to VS-17), POS/IT (links to VS-08/VS-27), Loss Prevention (links to VS-23), Audit (links to VS-21.3), BI (links to VS-28.1), Internal Controls (links to internal-controls-matrix)
fields.Trigger: Taxonomy mapping (W3690); control design; exception event
fields.Volume: Enterprise RA controls and exception queue

workflows.name: Revenue Assurance Controls & Exception Monitoring Framework

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Revenue Assurance Lead/Finance design and maintain the revenue-assurance controls" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "route exceptions to investigation" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track control-firing rate, exception-resolution cycle-time, false-positive…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: control-to-vector mapping; operational: threshold tuning
Pain Points / Risks: - **Control-gap risk**: A leakage vector has no detective control; mitigated by control-to-vector mapping
- **Alert-fatigue risk**: Too many false positives overwhelm investigation; mitigated by threshold tuning
System Touchpoints: - Exception reporting (links to VS-23.1/W837); internal controls matrix; POS/IT (links to VS-08/VS-27); BI (links to VS-28.1); audit (links to VS-21.3); investigation (links to W3705)

steps.activity: Revenue Assurance Lead/Finance design and maintain the revenue-assurance controls framework: preventive controls (system validations, price-lock, discount-stacking limits), detective controls (exception reports, threshold alerts, reconciliation), and corrective controls (recovery W3706); map each control to a leakage vector (W3690) and register in the internal-controls matrix
steps.r: Revenue Assurance Lead / Finance / Internal Controls

steps.activity: Revenue Assurance Lead/BI operate continuous exception monitoring: run exception-based reporting across pricing overrides, manual price changes, promo/loyalty/gift-card anomalies, refund/reversal spikes, catch-weight outliers, VAT/discount exceptions, and settlement variances; route exceptions to investigation (links to W3705/W3708)

Revenue Assurance Lead/Audit monitor control effectiveness: track control-firing rate, exception-resolution cycle-time, false-positive rate, and control-failure incidents; report control posture to audit (links to VS-21.3) and governance (links to W3689), and remediate ineffective controls

fields.Participants: Revenue Assurance Lead, Finance (links to VS-17.1/VS-17.4), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Marketplace (links to VS-95/VS-65), Retail Media (links to VS-48), AR (links to VS-16), Treasury (links to VS-18), BI (links to VS-28.1)
fields.Volume: POS + ecommerce + B2B/AR + marketplace/3P + retail media + services

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-reconcile of "reconcile each channel's gross-to-net to the GL" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-identify of "identify cross-channel leakage" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reported group revenue is complete and accurate across all channels and entities" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: full-channel consolidation; operational: timing-aware reconciliation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Channel-omission risk**: A revenue channel (e.g., retail media, marketplace commission) not reconciled to GL; mitigated by full-channel consolidation
- **Timing-mismatch risk**: Settlement timing differs from revenue recognition, creating false variance; mitigated by timing-aware reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - GL/close (links to VS-17.1); FP&A (links to VS-17.4); ecommerce (links to VS-10); marketplace (links to VS-95/VS-65); retail media (links to VS-48); AR (links to VS-16); treasury (links to VS-18); BI (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Revenue Assurance Lead/Finance consolidate revenue across all channels into a single reconciliation: in-store POS, ecommerce (BOPIS + delivery), B2B/AR billing, marketplace operator commission/fee, retail-media advertising, gift-card breakage, and services; reconcile each channel's gross-to-net to the GL (links to VS-17.1)

Revenue Assurance Lead reconcile channel-specific settlement: ecommerce payment-gateway settlement (links to VS-80), marketplace 3P-seller commission and payout (links to VS-95.3), retail-media billing (links to VS-48.3), and intercompany digital-commerce fees (links to VS-72); identify cross-channel leakage
steps.r: Revenue Assurance Lead / Ecommerce / Marketplace / Retail Media

steps.activity: Revenue Assurance Lead publish the consolidated multi-channel revenue reconciliation and any residual variance to month-end close (links to VS-17.1) and FP&A (links to VS-17.4), ensuring reported group revenue is complete and accurate across all channels and entities

fields.Participants: Revenue Assurance Lead, CFO, Finance (links to VS-17), POS/IT (links to VS-08/VS-27), Audit (links to VS-21), Loss Prevention (links to VS-23), CEO, Board (links to VS-36)

workflows.name: Revenue Assurance Policy, Authority & Approval Matrix

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "discount/override authority, promo/loyalty/gift-card integrity rules…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report policy/authority effectiveness to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: system gating and audit; operational: gating and audit; operational: annual review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Authority-bypass risk**: Revenue-impacting action taken without proper approval; mitigated by system gating and audit
- **Policy-staleness risk**: Outdated policy doesn't reflect current channels/pricing; mitigated by annual review
System Touchpoints: - Approval/workflow (links to VS-08/ERP approvals); internal controls matrix; governance (links to VS-36); audit (links to VS-21); authority matrix (links to VS-40)

steps.activity: Revenue Assurance Lead/CFO maintain the revenue-assurance policy: pricing-change governance, discount/override authority, promo/loyalty/gift-card integrity rules, refund/reversal authority, settlement-reconciliation standards, and the leakage-escalation threshold

Revenue Assurance Lead/CFO maintain the approval-authority matrix for revenue-impacting actions (price overrides, manual discounts, refund/value adjustments, write-offs of leakage) by value (Cashier → Supervisor → Store Manager → Finance → CFO per links to VS-36), aligned to the internal-controls matrix and board-delegated authorities

Revenue Assurance Lead/Audit enforce the policy and authority: gate high-risk revenue actions on approval, audit conformance, manage breaches, and report policy/authority effectiveness to governance (links to W3689) and audit (links to VS-21)

fields.Participants: Revenue Assurance Lead, Audit (links to VS-21.3), Finance (links to VS-17), Records (links to VS-88), Compliance (links to VS-22), Cross-Entity (links to VS-72)
fields.Trigger: Annual audit cycle; regulatory inspection; loss event

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records maintain the revenue-assurance documentation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "Revenue Assurance Lead/Audit conduct the annual revenue-assurance audit" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "posture to the audit committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-583 (ensure controlled execution — Revenue Assurance Strategy, Governance & Leak Detection Framework (PA-118.1).)
- operational: documentation discipline; operational: comprehensive annual audit
Pain Points / Risks: - **Records-gap risk**: Missing reconciliation/investigation records fail audit; mitigated by documentation discipline
- **Under-audit risk**: Revenue-assurance scope too narrow for external audit comfort; mitigated by comprehensive annual audit
System Touchpoints: - Records/retention (links to VS-88); audit (links to VS-21.3); compliance (links to VS-22); tax (links to VS-79); governance (links to VS-36); controls register (links to W3693)

steps.activity: Revenue Assurance Lead/Records maintain the revenue-assurance documentation: leakage taxonomy (W3690), controls register (W3693), reconciliations (W3691/W3694), exception-investigation records (W3705), recovery records (W3706), and the monthly W348 audit; retention per VS-88 and regulation

Revenue Assurance Lead/Audit conduct the annual revenue-assurance audit (extending W348): reconciliation integrity (W3691), control effectiveness (W3693), channel coverage (W3694), policy/authority conformance (W3695), leakage-recovery completeness (W3706), and reported-revenue accuracy; internal and (where required) external

Revenue Assurance Lead manage findings to closure, support external audit and BIR/SEC revenue-reporting defense (links to VS-22/VS-79), and report audit posture to the audit committee (links to VS-21/VS-36) and governance (links to W3689)
